liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Eleven** (3 reviews): Reviewer finds this performance of The Eleven phenomenal; Reviewer singles out The Eleven as especially ecstatic [5][10][14]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): The Dark Star, St. Stephen, Eleven stretch reveals new layers on each listen [10]
- **Alligator** (1 review): The Alligator, Drums, Power Jam, Caution, Feedback, We Bid You Goodnight sequence is called flawless [5]
- **Caution (Do not Stop on Tracks)** (1 review): The Alligator into Caution is described as one of the best ever played [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **Bill Graham Intro (Set One)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [16]
- **Bill Graham Intro (Set Two)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [16]
- **Cryptical Envelopment Reprise**: rare: 5 archived performances [16]
- **William Tell**: rare: 9 archived performances [16]
- **Drummers' Chant**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [16]
- **Power Jam**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [16]

## The recordings

- **gd69-02-28.sbd.16track.kaplan.3397.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 166 min; rated 4.5/5 by 48 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the sound top-notch, since the night was recorded with the Live Dead album in mind; Sound quality is said to approach a studio recording; Reviewer hears near-studio sound quality, with lush, layered playing [4][6][7][13]
- **gd1969-02-28.139196.sbd.2track.Gastwirt.Miller.Noel.t-flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 167 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1969-02-28.132672.sbd.multi.track.healy-latvala-wise.flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 165 min; rated 4.3/5 by 10 [3]

## Around the show

- Although taped for the Live Dead album, nothing from this night ended up on it [4]
- Reviewer ranks this night above the other shows in the 2/27 to 3/2 run [4]
- No other show packs Cryptical, The Other One, Dark Star, St. Stephen, The Eleven and Alligator/Caution/Feedback into one set [6]
- Reviewer considers 2/27 overrated, despite its use on Live/Dead, and prefers this show [8]
- Dick Latvala wrote in 1997 that this was the best, most exciting Dead show ever [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-02-28.sbd.16track.kaplan.3397.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Some patches in the master reel transfer are audible, and the channels should be swapped back in a future upload; Source is a 16-track master reel, transferred to DAT, then CD, EAC and SHN, with various patches; Credited to Charlie Miller, Aoxoa and Seth Kaplan; uploaded by Darrin Sacks [1][13]
- **gd1969-02-28.139196.sbd.2track.Gastwirt.Miller.Noel.t-flac16**: taped by Provided by Rich Gastwirt; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; SBD > 2-track Master Reels > Dat; Charlie Miller [2]
- **gd1969-02-28.132672.sbd.multi.track.healy-latvala-wise.flac16**: taped by Dan Healy; transferred by Dick Latvala and Jim Wise; source: flac16/48kHz ; Ampex MM-1000 16 Track Master Reels Two Inch Wide Tape @ 15 ips; Multi Track Mix-down To a Sony PCM 1630 By Dan Healy @ 44.1KHz); Set #1 DAT x… [3]

## Art and photos

- Photo by Caine Schneider (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - Fillmore West 1969-02-28 5LP](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/51569619903/) [17]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/51569619903/) [18]
